Method of Attack: Introduced an infinite loop printing gibberish non-ASCII characters endlessly on the console
Sabotaged code causing applications using these libraries to print gibberish data and break
Impacted Systems: Thousands of projects depending on 'colors' and 'faker'
Attack Vector: Malicious commits pushed to GitHub and npm repositories
Indicators of Compromise: Versions v1.4.44-liberty-2, 1.4.1, 1.4.2 of colors on npm
Console output containing 'LIBERTY LIBERTY LIBERTY' followed by non-ASCII characters
Date of Discovery: January 2022 (implied from timeline and article context)
